role: UI/UX Designer · Product Manager · Product Owner
summary: Single product decision-maker for two mobile apps and one website serving 3M+ registered users — Redz and Momyt Meet.
highlights: Lead product and design for two mobile apps and a website serving 3M+ registered users: Redz, a series-based video content app, and Momyt Meet, a meetups and friend-finding app, as the sole product decision-maker.
Own product strategy and the roadmap end-to-end, from discovery and requirements through design, validation, launch, and post-launch iteration.
Shipped Redz core features from concept to release: Series (solo and collaborative videos), Anonymous, an in-app Wallet, and the Verification and Premium subscriptions.
Defined and launched Momyt Meet's end-to-end meetup flow (create, invite, join, coordinate activities) and the Find feature, which connects users with people nearby or in a chosen location.
Drive discovery with usability tests, A/B tests, user feedback, and analytics data, and turn validated findings into prioritized backlog items and product iterations.

Own the Jira backlog, writing user stories and acceptance criteria that turn business goals into design and engineering tasks, and lead Agile/Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives).
Design user flows, information architecture, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes in Figma, and maintain the shared design system (components, typography, color, accessibility standards).
Trained and supervised two designers, guiding their work to keep design quality and consistency across the products.
Use AI tools (Figma AI, Figma Make, ChatGPT, Claude, Manus) to explore design ideas, prototype, write content, and synthesize research faster.

summary: Led the full redesign, revamp and rebuild of the Foras.ps platform, from requirements to sign-off.
highlights: Ran user research and competitor analysis and turned the findings into a new sitemap and information architecture for the whole platform.
Presented design decisions to stakeholders and iterated on feedback and usability testing.
Built the Foras design system from scratch — components, styles and guidelines — as one reusable foundation for every new page.

summary: Turned requests from departments and branches across the bank into internal software tools — where my engineering mindset comes from.
highlights: Gathered requirements directly from requesting teams and delivered new forms, system modifications and process improvements.
Maintained the tools in daily operations and improved their efficiency and documentation for easier support and handover.
